capabilities: render Obsidian Markdown inside Mermaid node labels
embed images, LaTeX math, tables and internal links in diagram nodes
size and position rendered HTML nodes within the Mermaid graph layout
extras: The README notes there are still known issues with the rendering approach that the author hopes to fix.
problem: Mermaid node labels in Obsidian only support plain text or HTML, so Obsidian Markdown such as LaTeX, tables and internal links cannot be shown inside nodes.

relations.evidence: Mehrmaid makes use of the Java Script library Mermaid library to render graphs.

summary: Mermaid extension that renders Obsidian Markdown, including images, math, tables and links, inside diagram node labels.
